user.title: Add a SmartHeat zone
user.description: SmartHeat opens and closes an on/off valve for one heating zone. It learns how far the room keeps warming after the valve closes, and closes early by that much.

data_description.name: Name of the zone, for example the room.
data_description.system_type: Sets sensible defaults for valve timing and safety limits.
data_description.valve: Switch, input boolean or valve that lets hot water into this zone.
data_description.room_sensor: Measures the room the zone heats.
data_description.return_sensor: Measures the water at the end of the loop, on the return pipe.
data_description.supply_sensor: Optional. Measures the water going in, to notice when no hot water is available.
data_description.window_sensor: Optional. The valve stays closed while it is open.

error.same_sensor: The room and return sensors must be different entities.

abort.already_configured: This valve is already used by a SmartHeat zone.

data_description.invert_valve: Turn on for a normally open actuator, where switching on closes the valve.
data_description.frost_temp: The valve opens below this temperature, even when the zone is off.
data_description.hysteresis: The valve opens when the room is this much below the target.
data_description.min_open_minutes: Thermal actuators need a few minutes to open fully.
data_description.coast_window_minutes: How long to wait for the room to peak after an early close.
data_description.max_return_temp: The valve closes above this, for example to protect the floor.
data_description.sensor_timeout_minutes: The valve closes when the room sensor has been unavailable this long.

error.same_sensor: The room and return sensors must be different entities.
error.min_above_max: The minimum temperature must be below the maximum.

abort.already_configured: This valve is already used by another SmartHeat zone.

reset_learning.name: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Forgets what SmartHeat has learned about this zone and starts again from the defaults.
